profile: Sivers Semiconductors develops semiconductor products through two business areas, Wireless and Photonics. Wireless supplies mmWave beamforming ICs, transceivers and antenna modules for satellite communications, fixed wireless access and 5G/6G networks. Photonics provides high-power lasers and related optical components for data communications, AI infrastructure, sensing and LiDAR applications. The company is also preparing for a potential dual listing in the United States.
